name: Death's Breach
summary: Death's Breach is an elevated staging ground situated in the far eastern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands, overlooking the Scarlet territories to the east. Connected to the Noxious Glade via a cavernous passage, this grim vantage point is gripped by the Scourge's insidious presence.

sections.title: A Grim Vantage
sections.body: Perched on a high ridge in the eastern portion of the Plaguelands, Death's Breach looks down upon the Scarlet Enclave and Havenshire below. It serves as a stark foothold carved against the mountain rim, reachable by navigating a dark tunnel that winds out of the Noxious Glade. Steep ramps lead downward from the high ground into the lower valleys, framing a perpetual flashpoint between the fanatical crusaders below and the creeping horrors of the Scourge.

aliases: how to get to deaths breach
faq.answer: Death's Breach sits upon high ground in the eastern heights of the Eastern Plaguelands, west of Havenshire and the Scarlet lands. It can be reached directly on foot through a tunnel emerging from the Noxious Glade.
Ramps on either side of the high ridge descend toward the eastern lowlands, where the Scarlet Crusade maintains settlements and fortifications in their isolated enclave.

faq.q: How do you reach Death's Breach from the western side?
faq.answer: Travelers navigate through the Noxious Glade in the Eastern Plaguelands, where a subterranean cave passage cuts eastward through the rock and opens directly onto the plateau.

angles.text: Overlooking the embattled lands of the Scarlet Crusade, this high cliffside serves as a grim reminder of how far the Scourge's corrupting grasp has reached into Lordaeron.
